## Predicted Lineups

Celje look set to line up with Leban in goal behind a back four of Sirvys, Bejger, Tutyskinas and Avdyli, with Kvesic and Zabukovnik in the middle of the park. Dukuly, Seslar and Verbic are expected to operate across the attacking midfield line, with Kramer leading the front line if he gets the nod to return after his weekend on the bench. [...] An unnamed Celje midfielder remains out with a knee injury picked up during a loan spell earlier in the year
 Right back Pijus Sirvys is pushing for a start after returning from injury as a late substitute against Maribor at the weekend
 Striker Blaz Kramer could come back into the starting eleven having dropped to the bench on Sunday
 For Salzburg, Nikolas Veratschnig, Justin Omoregie and Enrique Aguilar are all sidelined through injury [...] Salzburg should set up with Zawieschitzky between the sticks, a back four of Morgalla, Boma, Zabransky and Schmid, and Barry and Mazurek in central midfield. Redzic, Kitano and Lindstrom are expected across the forward areas, with Haris Tabakovic leading the line as the focal point of the attack.
